summary.text: Pamela Beidle, a Democrat, represents District 32 (Anne Arundel County) in the Maryland Senate and is listed on the Finance Committee (as chair), Executive Nominations Committee and Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Beidle was born in Maryland on July 21, 1951, and graduated from Archbishop Spalding High School in Severn.
The legislature's biography lists an A.A. in business from Anne Arundel Community College in 1977 and a B.S. in business administration, magna cum laude, from Towson University in 1994.

It lists Beidle as president of the Beidle Insurance Agency from 1979 to 2017, a member of the Anne Arundel County Council for Councilmanic District 1 from 1998 to 2006, and a member of the Maryland House of Delegates from 2007 to 2019.
